'''Natua Wan''' was a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[New Jedi Order]] in the period following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. She preferred to wear blue beads in her long black hair.

==Biography==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Wan was studying in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] when [[Jysella Horn]] was inflicted with a [[Force psychosis|mysterious illness]] that caused her to believe that everyone around her were impostors. Answering [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]]'s call to detain Horn, Wan quickly went to help. However, Horn tossed a bust at the Falleen, causing her to hit one of the stacks and fall unconscious.

Later, Wan and Jedi [[Radd Minker]] were assigned to patrol the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]] at the [[Grand Event Center]] with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. While viewing the Dangerous Animals exhibit, Jedi Wan was overcome by the same psychosis seen in the Horn children and [[Seff Hellin]]. Without notifying the Solo's (who she thought to be impostors), Wan quickly made her way to the control room, powering off the lights in the exhibit and locking all the exits. She than opened all of the exhibits, releasing the vicious and fierce animals unto the panicked crowd. In addition she dropped raw meat from the ceiling on to the walkway, and then began retracting the catwalk as the Jedi frantically attempted to cut open the doors.

As Wan was emptying the corrals, she used the Force to throw her voice to distract the "fake" Jedi. The two Solos and Minker eventually found her and engaged in a brief duel which ended when Minker rammed Wan with his head, rendering her unconscious.<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

Wan was brought to the [[Jedi Temple detention center]], where she was put in a cell located next to that of [[Raynar Thul]]. Natua was visited later by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. The Falleen attempted to use her [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] on Han, asking him to free her. However, the [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]] that were positioned in the Asylum Block prevented her efforts from working, and Solo declined her request. Later, Wan and the other infected Jedi were taken to [[Shedu Maad]] by Organa Solo.<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]], Wan and the other Jedi suffering from the mysterious Force psychosis snapped out of their delusions in the aftermath of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Mission to the Maw|first battle]] with [[Abeloth]] on [[Abeloth's planet]]. They were brought from Shedu Maad to the Jedi Temple by [[Zekk]] and [[Tekli]]. Wan participated in the [[Raid on Detention Center 81|rescue attempt]] of Jysella and [[Valin Horn]] as a member of "Team Saav'etu." Disguised as exterminators, the team used foam coating to mask the cam bubbles of the facility and then breached the outer walls with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. Inside, the team discovered thousands of prisoners frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] alongside the Horn siblings. Despite fierce opposition from [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces, the Horns were successfully rescued.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

Later that year, in an attempt to show her that the Jedi still trusted her, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Jaina Solo tasked her with researching information on ancient Sith planets such as [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in order to find [[Abeloth]] and [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]]. On the last planet the Jedi searched with all their numbers, [[Upekzar]], she was tasked by the Grand Master to explore the lava tunnels under the planet with [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Vestara Khai]]. When they encountered a mutated [[Rhak-skuri]] and Ben fell unconscious, Vestara wounded Natua so the beast would feed on her instead of Ben. She was then taken by the beast and killed, her corpse being dragged deeper into the tunnels.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>
